decoder_reconstruction.checkpoint_selection: repeated development VAL, predeclared MSE/patience; first strict minimum
decoder_reconstruction.patience_rule: consecutive completed epochs without strict improvement over the current best candidate
decoder_reconstruction.training_loss: sum squared error / original observed entry count

native_forecasting_head.criterion: sqrt(observed entry MSE) + observed entry MAE, first argmin
native_forecasting_head.implementation: centered sklearn Ridge objective via mask-group Gram eigendecomposition
native_forecasting_head.deviation: Missing labels excluded using original mask; repeated development VAL selects alpha.

ridge_math_verification.fixture: 17 train x9,6 outputs,3 original mask patterns,13 alphas,independent sklearn

native_forecasting_head.native_forecasting_deviation: No calendar covariates, common TRAIN-only scaler and original observed masks; origins require full common L512 history.

calibration.input: actual frozen F TRAIN latent predictions, never E(encoded true future)
